Self-service kiosks

Customers order at a kiosk and pay by card or QR, so till queues shrink and the average order grows. An MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 120 mln; the full version in 12–20 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline and price

Timeline
MVP 6–10 weeksFull 12–20 weeks
Price
MVP UZS 120–245 mln $10,000–20,000Full UZS 300–665 mln $25,000–55,000Rate: Central Bank of Uzbekistan, 21.10.2026, $1 = UZS 12,012
Per month
UZS 0.4–2.5 mln your own running costs: hosting, SMS and other services
Difficulty
medium
Who it is for
Restaurants and cafes, Retail, Clinics, Hotels, Public sector

  • iiko

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Kiosk app (ordering or check-in) for one location
  • Menu or service catalogue with photos
  • Card terminal and Click or Payme QR
  • Receipt printing
  • Link to the kitchen or staff
What the full version adds
  • Upsell suggestions
  • Three languages
  • Central content management for every kiosk
  • Remote monitoring
  • Loyalty login
  • Accessibility mode
Please note

Kiosk hardware usually costs $1,500–5,000 per unit and is quoted separately.

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today: who does what
  • Existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system
  • 1–2 staff to try the system

Questions

What does “Self-service kiosks” cost?
The MVP costs $10,000–20,000 (UZS 120–245 mln), the full version $25,000–55,000 (UZS 300–665 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Self-service kiosks” take?
The MVP takes 6–10 weeks, the full version 12–20 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
How the work runs today: who does what; Existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system; 1–2 staff to try the system.
